text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur got injured during training, so 
we came to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, did I think too much while running? 
Made a stupid damn mistake.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever, an irregularity of this level 
is something I can crush as many times as 
it takes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Right then, back to training. Treatment's 
all done.
choice_data_list: You should really get some proper rest.
Let's at least keep the training light.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What, is this some kind of joke? If we 
counted every little thing like this as an 
injury, we'd never hear the end of it.
choice_data_list:
An injury is an injury—if it's a question 
of 0 or 1, it's a 1.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Don't give me such annoying 
analogies.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...It's a waste of time just tagging 
along. I'll organize data in my room. You 
got no complaints about that, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking dissatisfied, Air Shakur 
nonetheless headed back to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll decide for myself whether to take it 
easy. Either way, efficiency is going to 
drop, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we headed toward the track—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While having her do a light jog, Air 
Shakur's face contorted in pain.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk. Why does nothing ever go my way?
choice_data_list: It's probably best to call it here.
It's probably best to call it here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're just statin' the obvious. 
Annoying...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur muttered discontentedly and 
headed back to the dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...If it's just a light jog, there's no 
problem. Doesn't seem like my body's gonna 
get rusty."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Might as well collect some injury data 
while I'm at it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur trained within a reasonable 
limit, taking care not to risk any injury.
